provenance.paper: Goldberg, A. E. (1995). Constructions: A Construction Grammar Approach to Argument Structure. University of Chicago Press.
provenance.locus: Ch. 1-2 -- the ditransitive construction (X CAUSES Y to RECEIVE Z); 'Pat faxed Bill the letter' shows the construction (not the verb 'fax') supplying the transfer meaning.

paper.title: Constructions: A Construction Grammar Approach to Argument Structure
paper.section: Ch. 1-2 — the ditransitive construction (X CAUSES Y to RECEIVE Z); 'Pat faxed Bill the letter' shows the construction (not the verb 'fax') supplying the transfer meaning
paper.claim: 'pat faxed bill the letter' is licensed by the ditransitive construction; 'fax' is lexically transitive, so the CAUSE-RECEIVE meaning is contributed by the construction (coercion).
